It's such a cute and interesting game to play with friends!! I love it so much :) It never gets boring, definitely recommend if you wanna have fun, playing the lvls alone tho... Its a challenge.
Fun, challenging, multiplayer. What more can you want in a game? I have yet to find another cooperative game to top this one. Honestly, I can only dream that one day the series will continue.

Played with friends as a 4 stack. Everyone has their own role to be doing. Fun but also sometimes challenging. The amount of laughs and fun which came from this game was insane just from a cooking game. Thank you for an amazing game!

So buggy for online mulitplayer gaming :( we have to keep restarting the game as it either gets stuck in the loading screen, or players dont move during the game/very laggy. Can' t recommend this until they fix this issue for everyone :( All internet connections and game requirements met and even exceeded as well, yet problems persist.

Got this game after having heaps of fun in Overcooked. Overcooked 2 lived up to my expectations and continued the fun co-op game-play from the original. The game catered to players of all skill levels, with 4 different star rating goals to work towards in each level.

The graphics still hold up, although they're a bit plain by today's standards. The music generally works and sets the mood but is nothing special.

The levels always provide challenge in some form or another. Although some levels really went out of their way to be just plain annoying, such as randomizing the level layout several times as you play through it.

The DLC provides a whole heap of new levels to play through, and I've found it well worth it.

Definitely recommended if you liked the first Overcooked or simply enjoy co-op games!

Super fun with friends, impossible to play alone. Similar to time management mobile cooking games I used to play. The maps get a bit frustrating at times and the mechanics are a little wonky but I really enjoy the idea of the game and graphics. It also gets laggy at times and it crashes when you play on high graphics but overall recommend this game to play for streams or amongst a small group of friends. Wish there were more maps and free content, you were to grind the game, you could finish it in 4 hours. 7.5/10
Like, I'm pickin up what it's puttin down and the idea of it is solid, but the wacky maps make it so difficult to play that it stops being fun with like medium to high regularity.

A great example on how a local coop game should be. I heavily recommend playing with a total of 3 players. While it may not seem balanced for an odd number of players, I find that it requires teamwork far more as the tasks can no longer be divided properly, requiring players to keep on adjusting plans and activity. That is what makes a good coop game great.
Before every game with your partner, say a vow to not split up/ super fun game
This is stressful, but hilarious and cute. The plot is a bit out there, but the game is quite wholesome (until you play with really competitive friends)

People always talked about it and it's actually so much fun to play with friends! I only played it for a little bit and I honestly suck at it, but it seems like a cool game to hit up with friends here and there.
i revoke my previous review, and i hate for my own mistake, this game very good yet frustating. i hope they have independent server and not using p2p like game

This is easily one of the most fun games I've ever played! It's the best when played multiplayer. - and that's one of my gripes about this game. There should be some A.I. in solo player or some sort of extra time bonus because playing solo is stupidly hard. Also, I noticed that the meal prep (chopping) is maybe half as fast when played solo. - which I don't think is a problem on the Switch version of the game. Fix that, and this game would be almost flawless.
a great time with friends, its fun and has nice visuals. Its best quality is the ability to unite friends and yet somehow make you hate them at the same time 10/10 game.

This is - by far - the best Couch Coop game I have ever played. The first part over Overcooked was already absolutely loved by me and my friends and I spent hours on it until I knew every single level off by heart.
This game is not only funny but the combination of concentrating, coordinating and communicating is always a fun challenge.

If you want to have fun with your friends and maybe a big ass fight as to why none of you wahed the dishes and now the food is burning - buy this game.

Great gameplay, not just and ordinary cooking game you know. Pretty fun, especially when you play with your friends (it tests your teamwork tho), I even got to fight w/ my brother while playing this lol
The best part is you can choose to play co-op online or couch as you please.
Overall, this is a really great game, good job developers
do i love this game or hate this game? depends on the level i guess but do i have fun playing this game hell yeahh. Super fun game and made some lovely friends with this game :)

I used to think that my girlfriend had a loving and gentle soul
Every time I see her I remember that I spent $25 to be yelled at to get rice and chop shrimp
We are still together, and we will play it more (It's very fun)

11/10 would recommend buying it to play with your partner before marrying because you might call the marriage off
Lots of fun. Cut carrots. Steamed em. Yelled at my girlfriend for throwing it in the garbage when trying to put it on a plate. Broke up with her. Cried. Then got 3 stars. Would recommend.

Play if you have friends. Game is great with friends.
Don't get if you have no friends. Singleplayer is not that fun.

All in all, it's a super fun coop game that I like to play with friends. I have to agree that the predecessor was much more challenging, but this one has levels that make you think out of the box, so kudos to that :)
Definitely recommend for a good time!
Levels are a bit more creative than the first game's and the throwing mechanic is a nice touch. It's an overall pretty fun game that you can enjoy with friends for hours on end.

When you finish Overcooked 1 among the many good things you think about game one was "wow, how creative these guys are to make the levels, impossible to have creativity for a second game". Well, they did, and they did it very well. Needless to say, how fun and charismatic this game is, the perfect option to play coop, play with family, friends, etc., but the highlight here is to do new things with the game that are different, not a repeat of the first and most of all (something they managed to do very well) is not to make the gameplay sickening. If you wanna have fun and enjoy good laughs don't think twice, go for Overcooked 2

A fun game to play with friends and developers continue to add seasonal updates! Has good replay value with the arcade and different assortment of levels. Online play can be difficult without being able to communicate amongst one another. Overall would recommend.
It's a fun cooking game, the story is good it's a little challenging too but in all the best part was playing with my family and cooking together.

Loved overcooked and now overcooked 2. Fun to play with friends/wife. Lots of cool new additions from the first overcooked including throwing, new cooking items, playing online..

Problems I have with Overcooked 2 is the levels seemed easy until you unlock the 4 stars (which then they are impossible). My biggest complaint is if you use gamecube controllers like myself there many times I will "double pick up" or randomly throw things which gets really annoying!
Love this game! So much fun. I like that it is possible to beat the game in single player. I've replayed it several times and can't wait for more.

This is such a cute and fun cooperative game. It is really satisfying when you learn how to play a level with friends and optimize the making of your recipes. I will warn you that it can really test your friendships.
awesome game, certainly a game i love playing with my friends and its just the perfect amount of chaos (although it is a bit hard sometimes to get levels with only 2 people)

I already enjoyed Overcooked and Overcooked 2 does not disappoint. It's again humorous and full of puns, fun levels AND it has multiplayer which was missing in the first one. The levels are not as challenging anymore - it's fairly easy to reach 3 stars - but after you've completed the story, you unlock the possibility to gain a fourth star in every level which seems impossible. I've seen videos of people doing it but you have to do everything perfect. I think it's a good compensation for the story being a bit too easy.

I love this game. Making food with others while being timed and trying to find the best strategies for cooking with your friends are some of the reasons I love this game. Enjoy stressful moments with companions, being rushed by people you call friends, you would love this game, it is simply made for you.

Cute artstyle, fun soundtrack.
This is one of those cooperative games that thrives on its own chaos. Level design is ingenious and frustrating at the same time.

Just as good as the first one, but Overcooked! 2 feels even better with the new throwing mechanic, extra levels, and new recipes. Loved that my boyfriend and I could actually play proper online co-op this time without needing Steam Remote Play Together, thanks to the new online multiplayer mode. It’s really useful when we’re not in the same place. I’d recommend both this and the original as they’re much the same really, so if you enjoyed one, you’ll definitely like the other. 10/10 again!

I have played overcooked in many different places, setups, houses, with many different people and it's always so great, I love cussing at my friends and family (lighthearted). This game is so fun and well made. I love the art and how it works. Be sure to get it in a bundle with overcooked 1 cuz both are very good.
Great game to play with friends. Found it boring by myself but group play makes it worth the play through the easy but painfully hard levels.

10/10. Played through the entire game with my wife. It really tests your reflexes and how well you can communicate when things are literally on fire. If you want a game that hones your multitasking skills and teamwork, this is the one. Just try not to yell at each other too much!

It's one of those games where you have to play with at least one other person as you will be yelling/crying to "throw the dang meat" or to "get out of the way" to get to the rice that is about to burn. This game is one like monopoly, a relationship tester. This game is really fun with more people because of the anxiety-producing chaos.
The only things I'm going to cook in this game are my friends if they DON'T PASS ME THE FREAKING LETTUCE.
Cool cooking game that's totally worth playing with friends, almost a torture alone but it helps your coordination if you play it that way

I 3 starred every mission within around 6 hours of game time, and honestly, it would have been faster if every second mission I didn't have to alt+F4 because the game failed to load missions and froze on the loading screen. Also, the last mission of the game was pretty lackluster and probably one of the easiest missions in the game to 3 star. I did most of the game, earning a score on most missions of approximately 2x the required amount for 3 stars and only a few missions required a 2nd try to get full star rating. When playing multiplayer, there were several lag spikes, to the point my friends froze in place for about 30 seconds, multiple times. On the note of multiplayer, only the host earns achievements, chefs, and any sort of progress. I wish the unbread made more of an appearance rather than the odd points on the world map and the beginning cutscene. It is a good, fun game, but not worth the full asking price. Quite disappointing especially coming from the first game expecting it to be better, like a sequel should be.
A stressful yet a fun a game that can be played among friends. This game also can fix your relationships with your significant other.

This game is really fun to play with your partner, friends or family. You will have hours of endless fun yelling at each other because the cake burned before you learn to communicate! I like the animation style too.
this game is perfect for friends. yall gotta work on teamwork skills fr HAHAHA its funny and the best game ever if you wanna get closer to ur friends xd

The stress is real! This game and its music is so good but once you get further and further in the story mode the game becomes pretty stressful. I did expect the game to be that way and it is fun throwing food left and right across various kitchens to make food with my friends but it takes serious communication and coordination to win. Nevertheless, if you up for a real challenge that is entertaining and perfect to play with friends then this is the game for you. Just try not the throw all of your chopped goods off the edge like I did.

(Graphics)
7/10

(How much fun it is)
8/10

This is the absolute most horrible game I've ever played. It's so stressful, it physically hurts to play for extended periods. No other keyboard-based arcade game requires me to stretch after playing. Playing it, I've screamed at the people who used to be my friends and alienated my family with my slander upon themselves and their bloodline, including me, for failing to get burgers to me fast enough.

10/10

This is a very cool game and great to kill time. The levels are hard sometimes, which poses a challenge and I personally struggle with them from time to time. However, overall it is a great game to play with your friends to bond and have fun.

I do not recommend this game to people with a short temper

Doesn't support Playstation Controller icons - only Xbox (all it takes is an option in the settings to set the controller type if you're too lazy to put a simple piece of code to detect the controller type).
Buttons and activities aren't straight forward.
